raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

FastAPI 0.137 ([fastapi#15745](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/15745)) changed `include_router()`: child routes are no longer flattened into `app.routes`; they become `_IncludedRouter` wrapper objects that can match a request but expose no `.path`. The Prometheus HTTP middleware's `_get_fastapi_request_path()` iterates `app.routes` and unconditionally reads `route.path` on a full match, so any request to an included route raises `AttributeError: '_IncludedRouter' object has no attribute 'path'`, which Starlette surfaces as **HTTP 500**. SGLang registers its endpoints via `include_router`, so every API endpoint fails under FastAPI >=0.137. Fixes #28887.

## Modifications

- `_get_fastapi_request_path()` now guards the `.path` access and, when the matching route is an included-router wrapper (no `.path`), descends into the wrapped router's routes (`original_router.routes`, or a generic `.routes`) to recover the templated path. It still falls back to the raw URL path when nothing resolves, so it never raises.
- Added a unit test in `test/registered/unit/utils/test_common.py` covering the included-router path and the unmatched-path fallback.

## Accuracy Tests

No model/output change -- this only fixes route-path resolution for the metric label. Verified against FastAPI 0.138 / Starlette 1.3: pre-fix the FULL-matching route is an `_IncludedRouter` and `route.path` raises; post-fix the templated path (`/v1/chat/completions`) is recovered, a normal route (`/docs`) is unchanged, and an unmatched path falls back to the raw URL.

## Checklist

- [x] Format/lint with ruff (change adds no new lint errors)
- [x] Add unit tests

files.patch:
@@ -1688,11 +1688,30 @@ async def track_http_status_code(request, call_next):
 def _get_fastapi_request_path(request) -> Tuple[str, bool]:
     from starlette.routing import Match
 
-    for route in request.app.routes:
-        match, child_scope = route.matches(request.scope)
-        if match == Match.FULL:
-            return route.path, True
+    def _match_path(routes, scope):
+        for route in routes:
+            match, child_scope = route.matches(scope)
+            if match != Match.FULL:
+                continue
+            path = getattr(route, "path", None)
+            if path is not None:
+                return path
+            # FastAPI >=0.137 no longer flattens included routers into
+            # app.routes; the matching wrapper (e.g. _IncludedRouter) exposes no
+            # `.path`. Descend into the wrapped router's routes to recover the
+            # templated path instead of raising AttributeError (#28887).
+            nested = getattr(
+                getattr(route, "original_router", None), "routes", None
+            ) or getattr(route, "routes", None)
+            if nested:
+                resolved = _match_path(nested, {**scope, **(child_scope or {})})
+                if resolved is not None:
+                    return resolved
+        return None
 
+    path = _match_path(request.app.routes, request.scope)
+    if path is not None:
+        return path, True
     return request.url.path, False

@@ -1,9 +1,11 @@
 import unittest
 from array import array
+from types import SimpleNamespace

 from sglang.srt.utils.common import (
+    _get_fastapi_request_path,
     flatten_arrays_to_int64_tensor,
     get_device_sm_nvidia_smi,
     get_nvidia_driver_version_str,
@@ -50,6 +52,52 @@ def test_multiple_parts(self):
         self._check(parts, [10, 20, 30, 100, 200, 1000])
 
 
+class TestGetFastapiRequestPath(CustomTestCase):
+    """`_get_fastapi_request_path` resolves the templated route path for the
+    Prometheus HTTP middleware. FastAPI >=0.137 no longer flattens included
+    routers into ``app.routes`` -- they become wrapper objects without a
+    ``.path`` -- which used to raise AttributeError -> HTTP 500 on every
+    request (#28887).
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _request(app, path):
+        scope = {
+            "type": "http",
+            "method": "GET",
+            "path": path,
+            "headers": [],
+            "query_string": b"",
+            "root_path": "",
+        }
+        return SimpleNamespace(app=app, scope=scope, url=SimpleNamespace(path=path))
+
+    def test_included_router_path_is_resolved(self):
+        from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        router = APIRouter()
+
+        @router.get("/v1/chat/completions")
+        def _endpoint():
+            return {}
+
+        app.include_router(router)
+        path, handled = _get_fastapi_request_path(
+            self._request(app, "/v1/chat/completions")
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(path, "/v1/chat/completions")
+        self.assertTrue(handled)
+
+    def test_unmatched_path_falls_back(self):
+        from fastapi import FastAPI
+
+        app = FastAPI()
+        path, handled = _get_fastapi_request_path(self._request(app, "/nope"))
+        self.assertEqual(path, "/nope")
+        self.assertFalse(handled)
+
